text:
Carla: FYI opened PR 5012 to sync Optimize toolkit docs: add Java + Rust snippets, minor KV-prefetch wording, and a quant-profile example. Need quick review + link check.

Omar: Pinged. Which link is flaky?

Carla: The console pointer goes to /opt/kv by mistake; should be /console/optimize/kv-prefetch. Also Rust block has an extra backtick that breaks the renderer.

Jun: I can take the Rust fix and run cargo check. Which crate name?

Carla: `optkit_examples`. Rust snippet: 

```rust
let client = Optimize::from_env();
let req = Batch::builder().model("redwood/13b-q").batch_size(4).build();
let out = client.batch(req).await?;
println!("got {} results", out.len());
```

Jun: Fixed stray backtick and added tokio note. cargo check passes locally. Pushed commit 2.

Omar: I updated the console link and added a tiny inline anchor to the quant-profile section. Also updated Java imports to `ai.redwood.optimize`.

LintBot: PR 5012  style checks found: missing docblock on quant-profile example (docs/en/optimize/quant-profiles.md).

Carla: I'll add a 1-line docblock explaining the profile tradeoff.

DocsBot: l10n-checker: docs/en/optimize/kv-prefetch.md  missing i18n frontmatter.

Carla: Adding frontmatter in commit 4.

Omar: Ran the Java snippet with SDK 0.10.0; compiles but needs thread-safety comment added. Pushed minor update.

Carla: All green after l10n and lint fixes. Approving and merging now. Thanks everyone! :tada:
